notes:
Summary: Mid-market B2B product company building in-app assistant + search personalization. Currently on OtherProviderAI; evaluating migration path to Redwood Hosted then Dedicated. Strong emphasis on prompt parity and zero-regression for prioritized intents.

Recent activity/timeline:
- 2025-10-12: Intro call (AE: Maya) - high level requirements, cost sensitivity flagged.
- 2025-11-04: Security questionnaire sent; client needs SOC2 + SSO + KMS notes.
- 2026-01-08: Tech deep-dive w/ SE (Ravi) - walked through existing prompt templates, rate patterns (bursty mornings), and embedding index setup.
- 2026-02-01: Demo of Redwood Hosted API -> showed streaming and function-calling parity. Client asked about API compatibility layer for OtherProviderAI.
- 2026-02-15: Call recorded ff_9231z_call_2026-02-15 (Fireflies) - decision to run hosted POC for 2 weeks focusing on 6 canonical prompts + embedding migration.
- 2026-02-28: POC kickoff; ingest ~120k queries into test index.

POC scope & success metrics:
- Platform: start on Redwood Hosted (no data residency req for control group) -> goal to transition to Dedicated in Q3 if pass.
- Compatibility: use Redwood compat shim to accept OtherProviderAI-style calls; map responses to current template outputs.
- Parity targets: intent-level F1 >= 0.93 vs baseline; max delta hallucination incidents <=5% relative increase; response latency p95 <= 200ms for chat flows (current baseline ~170ms).
- Throughput: sustain 40-60 requests/sec peak with autoscale.
- Cost: target 20-30% lower token cost vs current vendor after batching + caching.

Technical notes / ask list from client:
- "We saw small regressions on product-fact answers during the first hosted test" — needs regression triage and model selection guidance.
- Wants a prompt comparison report (before/after) and an eval harness to run nightly smoke tests.
- Requires VPC peering for Dedicated; security team needs network diagram and KMS workflow for key rotation.
- EU customers: will need data residency assurances for rollout later (flagged as future blocker).

Sales/contracting notes:
- Finance has modeled a Dedicated commit vs hosted blended spend; leaning to start hosted POC and then finalize Dedicated sizing after 60 days of production metrics.
- Pricing ask: commit tiers with predictable unit price and defined overage behavior.

Quotes / customer voice:
- "We will not accept regressions on critical intents — that kills trust with our customers."
- "If Redwood can map our templates and show stable parity, we'll move to dedicated reserve for cost predictability."

Next steps (short):
- SE to deliver POC plan + test harness by 2026-03-03 (Ravi).
- AE to share pricing worksheet and draft MSA for mid-market seat counts by 2026-03-05 (Maya).
- Schedule security handoff with Redwood Security on VPC and KMS (Elena to coordinate).
